text: allAccountsSorted now filters accounts without an incomingServer and optionally removes IM accounts, then returns the account manager order. The retired GetSortOrder, compareAccounts and server-type ranking must not be recreated from this historical patch. ReorderAccounts preserves hidden accounts, requires all existing keys, swaps m_accounts, and writes the accounts preference. The helper name and its older sort description do not establish a current type-based ranking contract. These conclusions come from static source inspection. No runtime test or accessibility session was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Keep account order with the account manager rather than the retired type sorter
